chunks: From him, from Sulaymān ibn Dāwūd, from ʿAlī ibn Abī Ḥamzah, from Abū Baṣīr, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
The time of Maghrib is when the sun disappears.

key_terms.الْمَغْرِبِ: the Maghrib salat (prayer), the sunset prayer
key_terms.وَقْتُ: the appointed time or prescribed beginning of an act

ai.seo_question: When does the time of Maghrib salat (prayer) begin according to the hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states the onset of the time for Maghrib salat (prayer). It identifies sunset, when the sun disappears, as the defining point for the beginning of this prayer time.
